tasks.text: Review these seven Sui Mainnet transactions as research case notes. For each, report status, gas payer, net gas and exact balance changes in base units, plus any uncertainty. Check whether monitored wallet 0x77776760c06997206b13fa76f127aa016d24a645f04fce516be153ece0bddf23 is involved; do not assume it appears in every case.
